titulo: The extra line before the terminal
subtitulo: Ask for the bill, verify the total, remove an unauthorised tip and keep the receipt
frasePiso: Before the card touches the terminal, you can make the amount visible, identify an extra line and authorise only what you chose.

steps.pt: Recall the first-hour payment question. Before leaving the airport you asked whether card worked. Bring that question to the restaurant now, but do not let the terminal outrun the bill.

steps.promptPt: Recall B06. Before ordering, ask whether you can pay by card. Speak now.
steps.pt: Can I pay by card?
The meal is finished. Ask for the bill before asking for the terminal. The paper or screen gives you something you can inspect.

steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah KWEN-tah por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you bring me the bill, please?

steps.promptPt: The plates are clear but no bill has arrived. Ask for it. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah KWEN-tah por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you bring me the bill, please?
Of course, I’ll bring it now.

Prices in a Mexican restaurant should be shown in pesos and include taxes. You do not need to produce a spoken number from memory. Ask for the total, then ask to see it if the answer runs past your ear.
What is the total?

steps.promptPt: The bill has several lines. Ask for the final amount. Speak now.
steps.pt: What is the total?
It’s eight hundred forty pesos.

steps.pinyin: meh loh PWEH-deh mohs-TRAHR por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you show it to me, please?

steps.promptPt: You did not catch the amount. Do not guess or practise arithmetic aloud; ask to see it. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: meh loh PWEH-deh mohs-TRAHR por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you show it to me, please?

Your finger stops on a line you did not choose. Do not accuse and do not pay first. Ask what the charge is. If it is a tip added without your consent, name the missing authorisation and ask for removal.
What is this charge?

steps.promptPt: There is an extra line on the bill. Point to it and ask what it is. Speak now.
steps.pt: What is this charge?
It’s the tip.

steps.es: No autoricé este cargo. ¿Puede quitarlo, por favor?
steps.pinyin: noh ow-toh-ree-SEH EHS-teh KAHR-goh PWEH-deh kee-TAHR-loh por fah-BOR
steps.pt: I did not authorise this charge. Can you remove it, please?
steps.tts: No autoricé este cargo. ¿Puede quitarlo, por favor?

steps.promptPt: The server says the unrequested line is the tip. State that you did not authorise it and ask for removal. Speak now.
steps.es: No autoricé este cargo. ¿Puede quitarlo, por favor?
steps.pinyin: noh ow-toh-ree-SEH EHS-teh KAHR-goh PWEH-deh kee-TAHR-loh por fah-BOR
steps.pt: I did not authorise this charge. Can you remove it, please?
Yes, I’ll remove it.

Removing an unauthorised line does not forbid a voluntary tip. Choose your own amount after the corrected total. This lesson gives no universal percentage: service, setting and your decision vary. If speaking the number is fragile, show the amount on your phone.

steps.es: Quiero agregar esta cantidad de propina.
steps.pinyin: KYEH-roh ah-greh-GAHR EHS-tah kahn-tee-DAHD deh proh-PEE-nah
steps.pt: I want to add this amount as a tip.
steps.tts: Quiero agregar esta cantidad de propina.

steps.promptPt: The corrected bill is in front of you. Show the amount you chose on your phone and say you want to add that amount as a tip. Speak now.
steps.es: Quiero agregar esta cantidad de propina.
steps.pinyin: KYEH-roh ah-greh-GAHR EHS-tah kahn-tee-DAHD deh proh-PEE-nah
steps.pt: I want to add this amount as a tip.
All right. I’ll add it.
Now the total is the total you approved. Ask for the terminal to come to you, compare the amount on its screen with the corrected bill, then pay.

steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah tehr-mee-NAHL por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you bring me the card terminal, please?

steps.promptPt: The corrected bill is ready and you are keeping the card with you. Ask for the terminal. Speak now.
steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah tehr-mee-NAHL por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you bring me the card terminal, please?
Yes, here it is.
Close the loop with evidence. Ask for the receipt and keep it until the charge appears correctly. The receipt is not clutter; it is the last checkable artifact in the scene.

steps.es: ¿Me puede dar el recibo, por favor?
steps.pinyin: meh PWEH-deh dahr el reh-SEE-boh por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you give me the receipt, please?
steps.tts: ¿Me puede dar el recibo, por favor?

steps.promptPt: Payment went through. Ask for the receipt before you leave. Speak now.
steps.es: ¿Me puede dar el recibo, por favor?
steps.pinyin: meh PWEH-deh dahr el reh-SEE-boh por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Can you give me the receipt, please?
Of course, here you are.

steps.es: ¿Me trae la cuenta, por favor? ¿Cuál es el total? ¿Qué es este cargo? ¿Me trae la terminal, por favor?
steps.pinyin: meh TRAH-eh lah KWEN-tah por fah-BOR. kwahl ehs el toh-TAHL. keh ehs EHS-teh KAHR-goh. meh TRAH-eh lah tehr-mee-NAHL por fah-BOR
steps.pt: Shadow the bill, total, extra-charge and terminal sequence.
steps.tts: ¿Me trae la cuenta, por favor? ¿Cuál es el total? ¿Qué es este cargo? ¿Me trae la terminal, por favor?

steps.pt: B14 complete. Bill before terminal. Total visible instead of guessed. Unknown line identified. Unauthorised tip removed. Your own tip chosen without a universal percentage. Terminal amount compared, receipt kept. You authorised the payment instead of merely completing it.

aprofundar.titulo: The bill is an approval surface

secoes.titulo: Pesos and taxes are already part of the display
secoes.corpo: Restaurant prices should be shown in Mexican pesos and include taxes. A dollar figure may also appear, but the national-currency price remains the anchor.

secoes.titulo: A voluntary tip needs your choice
secoes.corpo: Profeco states that a tip cannot be demanded or included without the diner’s consent. Removing an unauthorised line and choosing a voluntary amount are separate actions.

secoes.titulo: Show numbers when speech is brittle
secoes.corpo: B14 trains receptive numbers. On the productive side, point to the bill, terminal or phone; the result matters more than performing arithmetic in Spanish.

secoes.titulo: The terminal waits for the bill
secoes.corpo: Ask for the bill, inspect it, then bring the terminal into the scene. Compare the corrected total and keep the receipt as the final checkable artifact.
